name: Mubly Blocks
author: Mohit Chawla

sections.description:
Mubly Blocks adds focused block editor blocks that help site owners create useful calls to action and publishing experiences directly in the block editor.

Included blocks:

  • Trusted Source CTA: Invite readers to add the site as a trusted source on Google using Google’s preferred source URL format.
  • Key Takeaways: Highlight the most important article points in a clean summary block.
  • Pro & Con List: Present review or comparison points with custom checkmarks and crosses.
  • Step-by-Step Process: Build flexible process steps that can contain normal WordPress blocks.
  • Author Block: Display an author profile card with a bio, avatar, and website or archive link.

The Trusted Source CTA block includes Classic, Compact, Spotlight, and Button Only design styles. Editors can choose a style from the block settings panel.

The Key Takeaways block includes Clean List, Accent Box, and Numbered Notes design styles. Editors can customize the heading, intro, and takeaway items directly in the block.

The Pro & Con List block includes Side by Side, Stacked, and Compact Cards design styles. Editors can customize headings, list items, background color, text color, and pro/con accent colors.

The Step-by-Step Process block includes Timeline, Cards, and Compact design styles. Each process step can contain regular WordPress blocks such as images, lists, headings, paragraphs, buttons, and embeds.

The Author Block includes Card, Minimal, and Spotlight design styles. Editors can insert author details manually or use a WordPress author profile. The button can link to the author website or the author archive.

The plugin does not track users, does not collect personal data, and does not load remote scripts or styles. The Trusted Source CTA block can output a normal front-end link to Google when the site editor adds the block to content.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the mubly-blocks folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate Mubly Blocks through the Plugins screen in WordPress.
  3. Open the block editor and insert the Trusted Source CTA or Author Block block.
  4. Customize the block settings in the sidebar if needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require a Google account or API key?

No. The block creates a standard link to Google’s source preferences page.

Does the plugin send visitor data to Google?

No. The plugin does not call Google APIs or load Google-hosted scripts. If a reader clicks the CTA link, they leave your site and visit Google.

Can I change the source domain?

Yes. Select the block in the editor and use the Source domain field in the block settings.

Can I change the block design?

Yes. Select the block and choose a style from the Design settings panel.

Can the Author Block use a WordPress author profile?

Yes. Select the Author Block and choose Use author profile from the Author Details settings. You can use the current post author or select a specific author.

Can the Author Block button link to an author archive?

Yes. In the Button settings, choose Author archive instead of Author website.

  • Added background, text, and accent color controls to the Key Takeaways block.
  • Added the Pro & Con List block with side-by-side, stacked, and compact card styles.
  • Added the Step-by-Step Process block with nested Process Step blocks that support inner WordPress blocks.

0.2.1

  • Improved Trusted Source CTA heading and paragraph spacing consistency across themes.
  • Added the Key Takeaways block with Clean List, Accent Box, and Numbered Notes styles.
  • Improved Author Block heading and paragraph spacing consistency across themes.

0.2.0

  • Renamed the plugin to Mubly Blocks and updated WordPress.org submission metadata.
  • Removed external project and author URLs from plugin metadata.

0.1.0

  • Initial release with the Trusted Source CTA block and Author Block.
